_notes: Mars terraforming, used by game/terraform.py. The stages happen one after another.
Each stage needs work_days of equipment time: 2190 means one atmosphere factory takes 6 years, three take 2.
Equipment only works on its own stage, at the site given by 'where'. Surface stages also need living crew at that site and power that isn't negative.

stages.name: Thicken the atmosphere
stages.done_text: The air is thick enough to keep heat in, and Mars is warming up.

stages.name: Melt the polar ice
stages.done_text: The ice caps are melting: Mars has rivers and lakes again.

stages.name: Seed a biosphere
stages.done_text: Moss and lichen are spreading: Mars is turning green.
